description: This file defines the class `Smarty_Internal_Method_ConfigLoad`, which provides internal methods for loading configuration files and variables into Smarty templates. It includes methods for loading config files, assigning config variables, updating variable stacks, and retrieving config variable values.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_ConfigLoad
classes.description: Internal class providing methods for loading and managing configuration data within Smarty templates.

methods.name: configLoad
methods.description: Loads a configuration file and optionally loads selected sections into a Smarty data object.

methods.name: _loadConfigFile
methods.description: Loads a configuration file into a Smarty_Internal_Template object, setting scope and caching options.

methods.name: _loadConfigVars
methods.description: Loads configuration variables into a Smarty template, considering scope and parent templates.

methods.name: _assignConfigVars
methods.description: Assigns configuration variables into a given scope, merging if necessary.

methods.name: _updateVarStack
methods.description: Updates the variable stack of a Smarty template with new configuration variables.

methods.name: _getConfigVariable
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration variable from a Smarty data or template object.
